## Load Library

```{r,message = F, warning=F}
set.seed(1234)
library(scran)
library(scuttle)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)
library(Matrix)
library(SpaTM)
library(DESeq2)
decon_df <- readRDS("./Manuscript/DESeq2/LS_decon.rds")
```

```{r}
rm_samples <- '/home/adrien/Desktop/LS_GTM/meta/remove_samples.txt'
meta_df <- '/home/adrien/Desktop/LS_GTM/meta/patient_meta.csv'
ls_meta <- '/home/adrien/Desktop/LS_GTM/meta/LS_Meta.csv'

meta_df <- read.csv(meta_df,header = T,na.strings = "N/A")
rownames(meta_df) <- meta_df$Patient
ls_meta <- read.csv(ls_meta, header = T,na.strings = "N/A")

rm_samples <- colnames(read.csv(rm_samples))
meta_df <- meta_df[!rownames(meta_df) %in% rm_samples,]
meta_df$Cond <- NA
meta_df$Cond[str_detect(rownames(meta_df),"CSU")] <- 'CSU'
meta_df$Cond[str_detect(rownames(meta_df),"LS")] <- 'LS'
meta_df$Cond[str_detect(rownames(meta_df),"N")] <- 'CTRL'
meta_df$Cond[str_detect(rownames(meta_df),"CTRL")] <- 'CTRL'
rownames(meta_df) <- str_replace(rownames(meta_df),"\\.","-")

meta_df$GCL <- NA
meta_df$GCL[match(ls_meta$Sample.Name,rownames(meta_df))] <- ls_meta$Subtype..HC..Generalized..Circumscribed..Linear.
meta_df$GCL[meta_df$Cond == 'CTRL'] <- 'Healthy'
meta_df$Activity <- NA
meta_df$Activity[match(ls_meta$Sample.Name,rownames(meta_df))] <- ls_meta$Activity..Healthy..Inactive..Active.
meta_df$Activity[meta_df$Cond == 'CTRL'] <- 'Healthy'
meta_df$Group <- NA
meta_df$Group[match(ls_meta$Sample.Name,rownames(meta_df))] <- ls_meta$Group..Fibrotic.Inflammatory.
meta_df$Group[meta_df$Cond == 'CTRL'] <- 'Healthy'
meta_df$Cond[meta_df$Cond == 'CTRL'] <- 'Healthy'


meta_df <- meta_df[meta_df$Cond != 'CSU',]

meta_df <- meta_df %>%
  dplyr::select(-Patient)

table(rownames(decon_df) == rownames(meta_df))
colnames(decon_df) <- str_replace_all(colnames(decon_df),'\\-','_')
colnames(decon_df) <- str_replace_all(colnames(decon_df),' ','_')

meta_df <- cbind(meta_df,as.data.frame(decon_df))
#Summarized Experiment
bulk_counts <- read.csv("./Data/final_counts.csv")
rownames(bulk_counts) <- bulk_counts[,1]
bulk_counts <- bulk_counts[,-1]

colnames(bulk_counts) <- str_replace(colnames(bulk_counts),'\\.','-')
bulk_counts <- bulk_counts[,rownames(meta_df)]
```

```{r}
meta_df$Batch <- 'Netchiporouk'
meta_df$Batch[str_detect(rownames(meta_df),'N')] <- 'LeFrancois2'
meta_df$Batch[rownames(meta_df) %in% c('N4','N5','N6','N9')] <- 'LeFrancois1'
```

```{r}
se <- SummarizedExperiment(assays = list(counts = bulk_counts),
                           colData = as(meta_df,'DataFrame'))

se <- se[!is.na(rownames(se)),]
se <- se[,se$Cond != 'CSU']
se$Group[is.na(se$Group)] <- 'Unknown'
#se <- se[,se$Group %in% c('Healthy','Inflammatory')]
se$Cond <- factor(se$Cond, levels = c('Healthy','LS'))
bulk.dge <- read.csv("./Manuscript/DESeq2/LS_Unfiltered.csv")

rownames(bulk.dge) <- bulk.dge$Gene
bulk.dge$GoI <- abs(bulk.dge$logFC) >= 1 & bulk.dge$adj.P.Val < 0.05
```

```{r}

cts_gex <- readRDS("./Manuscript/DESeq2/final_gex.rds")

cts_gex_samples <- colnames(cts_gex)
split_info <- strsplit(cts_gex_samples, "_")  # Split by the underscore
sample_names <- sapply(split_info, `[`, 1)   # Extract sample names
cell_types <- sapply(split_info, `[`, 2)     # Extract cell types


alt_meta_df <- data.frame(
  Sample = sample_names,
  Celltype = cell_types,
  row.names = cts_gex_samples
)

# Filter alt_meta_df to include only samples that match rownames of meta_df
filtered_alt_meta_df <- alt_meta_df[alt_meta_df$Sample %in% rownames(meta_df), ]

# Add metadata from meta_df to the filtered_alt_meta_df
filtered_alt_meta_df <- cbind(
  filtered_alt_meta_df,
  meta_df[filtered_alt_meta_df$Sample, ]
)

filtered_alt_meta_df <- filtered_alt_meta_df#[,!colnames(filtered_alt_meta_df) %in% cell_names]

se <- SummarizedExperiment(assays = list(counts = as.matrix(cts_gex)),
                           colData = as(filtered_alt_meta_df,'DataFrame'))
```

```{r,message=FALSE,warning=FALSE}

dge_res <- list()
full_res <- list()
assay(se,'counts') <- round(assay(se,'counts'))
print(unique(se$Celltype))
print(colnames(decon_df))
dds_all <- list()
for (cell in unique(se$Celltype)[apply(decon_df,2,median) > 1e-2]){
  cur_se <- se[,se$Celltype == cell]
  
  cur_se <- cur_se[,colSums(assay(cur_se,'counts')) > 0]

  cell_name <- str_replace_all(cell," ","_")
  cell_name <- str_replace(cell_name,"-","_")
  design <- reformulate(c('Cond',"Batch",cell_name))
  
  cur_dds <- DESeqDataSet(se = cur_se,
                          design = design)
  cur_dds <- DESeq(cur_dds,
                   sfType = "poscounts",
                   parallel = T,
                   quiet = T)
  dds_all[[cell]] <- cur_dds
  res.out <- lfcShrink(cur_dds, coef = "Cond_LS_vs_Healthy", type = "apeglm",quiet = TRUE)
  #res.out <- results(cur_dds,contrast = c('Cond','LS','Healthy'))
  res.out <- na.omit(res.out)
  full_res[[cell]] <- res.out
  full_res[[cell]]$Gene <- rownames(res.out)
  full_res[[cell]]$Celltype <- cell
  res.out <- res.out[abs(res.out$log2FoldChange) >= 1 & res.out$padj < 0.05,]
  if(nrow(res.out) < 1){
    next
  }
  
  res.out$Gene <- rownames(res.out)
  res.out$Celltype <- cell
  res.out$Total_Samples <- ncol(cur_se)
  dge_res[[cell]] <- res.out
}

dge_res <- lapply(dge_res,as.data.frame)
dge_res <- do.call('rbind',dge_res)
rownames(dge_res) <- NULL
dge_res$Overlap <- dge_res$Gene %in% bulk.dge$Gene[bulk.dge$GoI]
table(dge_res$Overlap)
length(unique(dge_res$Gene))
full_res <- lapply(full_res,as.data.frame)
full_res <- do.call('rbind',full_res)
full_res <- full_res %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Overlap = ifelse(abs(log2FoldChange) >= 1 & padj < 0.05,
                                 Gene %in% bulk.dge$Gene[bulk.dge$GoI],
                                 FALSE))
rownames(full_res) <- NULL


library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(AnnotationDbi)

# Map gene symbols to descriptions

# Map Ensembl IDs to gene symbols
dge_res$Symbol <- mapIds(
  org.Hs.eg.db,
  keys = dge_res$Gene,       # Use the Ensembl IDs from rownames of dge_res
  column = "SYMBOL",              # Retrieve gene symbols
  keytype = "ENSEMBL",            # Match based on Ensembl IDs
  multiVals = "first"             # Use the first match if multiple exist
)

# Map Ensembl IDs to gene descriptions
dge_res$Description <- mapIds(
  org.Hs.eg.db,
  keys = dge_res$Gene,       # Use the Ensembl IDs from rownames of dge_res
  column = "GENENAME",            # Retrieve gene descriptions
  keytype = "ENSEMBL",            # Match based on Ensembl IDs
  multiVals = "first"             # Use the first match if multiple exist
)


full_res$Symbol <- mapIds(
  org.Hs.eg.db,
  keys = full_res$Gene,       # Use the Ensembl IDs from rownames of dge_res
  column = "SYMBOL",              # Retrieve gene symbols
  keytype = "ENSEMBL",            # Match based on Ensembl IDs
  multiVals = "first"             # Use the first match if multiple exist
)

# Map Ensembl IDs to gene descriptions
full_res$Description <- mapIds(
  org.Hs.eg.db,
  keys = full_res$Gene,       # Use the Ensembl IDs from rownames of dge_res
  column = "GENENAME",            # Retrieve gene descriptions
  keytype = "ENSEMBL",            # Match based on Ensembl IDs
  multiVals = "first"             # Use the first match if multiple exist
)
View(dge_res)
```

```{r}

for (cell in unique(full_res$Celltype)){
  
  p <- full_res %>%
            dplyr::filter(Celltype == cell) %>%
            dplyr::mutate(GoI = abs(log2FoldChange) >= 1 & padj < 0.05) %>%
            dplyr::mutate(pvalue = ifelse(pvalue < 1e-10,1e-10,pvalue)) %>%
            ggplot(aes(log2FoldChange,-log10(pvalue),color = GoI, shape = Overlap)) +
            geom_point() + 
            labs(title = cell) +
            geom_text(
              data = . %>% dplyr::filter(GoI),  # Only label genes of interest
              aes(label = Symbol),             # Use the gene symbol as the label
              vjust = -0.5,                    # Adjust vertical position of text
              size = 3                         # Adjust text size
            )
  print(p)
}
```

```{r}
library(EnhancedVolcano)
ehan <- list()
for (cell in unique(dge_res$Celltype)){
    
  cur_res <- full_res %>%
              dplyr::filter(Celltype == cell) %>%
              dplyr::mutate(GoI = abs(log2FoldChange) >= 1 & padj < 0.01) %>%
              dplyr::arrange(desc(GoI),desc(abs(log2FoldChange))) %>%
              dplyr::mutate(pvalue = ifelse(pvalue < 1e-10,1e-10,pvalue))
  

  shape_keys <- ifelse(cur_res$Overlap,17,16)
  names(shape_keys) <- ifelse(shape_keys == 17,'Bulk DEG','Novel DEG')
  ehan[[cell]] <- EnhancedVolcano(cur_res,
                  lab = cur_res$Symbol,
                  selectLab = cur_res$Symbol[cur_res$GoI],
                  drawConnectors = TRUE,
                  x = 'log2FoldChange',
                  y = 'pvalue',
                  legendPosition = 'none',
                  ylim = c(0,10),
                  shapeCustom = shape_keys,
                  xlim = c(min(cur_res$log2FoldChange)-0.1,
                           max(cur_res$log2FoldChange))+0.1,
                  pCutoff = 1e-3,
                  title = str_to_title(cell),
                  subtitle = '')

}


lapply(names(ehan),function(a){
  print(ehan[[a]])
  ggsave(paste(a,"dge.pdf",sep = ''),device = 'pdf',
         width = 10,height = 8)
})
```

## Senesence Hits

```{r}
gene_sig <- read.csv("./Manuscript/senesence.csv",header = F)[,1]

sen_dge <- dge_res %>%
  dplyr::filter(Symbol %in% gene_sig)

sen_cels <- unique(sen_dge$Celltype)


```

```{r}

# Get the unique cell types from the senescence results
sen_cels <- unique(sen_dge$Celltype)

# Prepare an empty list for ggplot objects
senescence_plots <- list()

# Loop over each cell type and each gene in that cell type
for(cell in sen_cels){
  genes_in_cell <- sen_dge %>% 
    filter(Celltype == cell) %>% 
    distinct(Gene, Symbol)
  
  for(i in 1:nrow(genes_in_cell)){
    cur_gene <- genes_in_cell$Gene[i]
    cur_symbol <- genes_in_cell$Symbol[i]
    
    # Map the gene symbol to an Ensembl ID (if needed)
    cur_ID <- mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db,
                     keys = cur_symbol,
                     column = "ENSEMBL",
                     keytype = "SYMBOL",
                     multiVals = "first")
    
    # Retrieve count data using plotCounts from the DESeq2 object for the current cell type
    pdat <- plotCounts(dds_all[[cell]], gene = cur_ID, intgroup = "Cond", 
                       transform = TRUE, returnData = TRUE)
    
    # Retrieve the adjusted p-value from sen_dge for the current gene and cell type
    adj_p <- sen_dge %>% 
             filter(Celltype == cell, Gene == cur_gene) %>% 
             pull(padj)
    if(length(adj_p) == 0) {
      adj_p <- NA
    } else {
      adj_p <- adj_p[1]
    }
    
    # Define annotation data for Healthy vs LS comparison
    # Set the y.position slightly above the maximum count value
    y_pos <- log10(max(pdat$count, na.rm = TRUE)) * 1.1
    anno_df <- data.frame(
      group1 = "Healthy",
      group2 = "LS",
      p.adj = adj_p,
      y.position = y_pos
    )
    # Create a custom label displaying the adjusted p-value
    anno_df$label <- paste0("p.adj = ", format(anno_df$p.adj, digits = 2))
    
    # Create a ggpubr box plot with jitter and log-scaled y axis;
    # annotate the plot with the pre-computed adjusted p-value.
    pdat$count <- log10(pdat$count)
    p_obj <- ggboxplot(pdat, x = "Cond", y = "count", fill = "Cond",
                       add = "jitter", palette = c("#00AFBB",'#E63946')) +
      #scale_y_log10() +
      stat_pvalue_manual(anno_df,
                         label = "label",
                         xmin = "group1",
                         xmax = "group2",
                         y.position = "y.position",
                         tip.length = 0.01,
                         bracket.size = 0.5,
                         step.increase = 0.2,
                         size = 6) +
      labs(title = paste(str_to_title(cell), "-", cur_symbol),
           x = "Condition",
           y = "Norm. Expression (Log10)") +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
            axis.line.y = element_line(colour = 'black'),
            axis.line.x = element_line(colour = 'black'))
    
    # Store the plot in the list with a combined key
    plot_key <- paste(cell, cur_symbol, sep = "_")
    senescence_plots[[plot_key]] <- p_obj
  }
}

```
